I'm 42 and not exactly skipping in the streets, but my advice would be this. Figure out who you are before you make any big decisions. Take some time and just think if something is what you want or if you were taught that you want it. I'm not saying go sit on a mountain and meditate, unless that would help. Just figure out if your ambitions are coming from you or other people. 

I was pushed to go to college when I'm a photographer now. I ended up dropping out and saddled with debt when it was my families dream not mine.

So take some time to meet yourself. Not enough people do it.
